lines.line: Stack Overflow fires blocks from the top of its stack.
Its whip lashes out low, or straight up.
The beam fires all five blocks at once.
It parries from the side, and from above.
It crouches under a fling, then dashes past.
Below the stage, the whip grabs the ledge.
Everyone can punch, and kick low while crouching.
Holding parry keeps the shield up.
A dash with the shield up is a bash.
